headline: HuyenBao v11.12 — bigger toasts, fixed VI guide, online/offline time overhaul
summary: Four player-facing fixes: (1) Notification toasts are bigger (larger padding, font, radius, scrollable) and stay visible longer — duration is now adaptive (3.5s min, 8s max, ~55ms per character) so long messages don't vanish before you finish reading. (2) The Vietnamese how-to-play guide had broken phrasing ('bằng lái' for licence, 'tâm thế' for mood, 'VŨ TRỤ' for space) — all fixed, and a new guide.7 line explains that random good/bad events fire during your career and business. (3) Online time now runs at 30 real-seconds per game day (was 20s). (4) Offline time is no longer paused: closing the tab advances the world at 10 real-minutes per game day (capped at 30 days), and each unmonitored business faces extra closure risk + operational losses while you're away — a summary toast tells you what happened. The AI-oracle event rate is also bumped from 3% to 4% per game-day so in-work situations fire more often.
features: Toasts: adaptive duration (3.5–8s by message length) + bigger box (padding 14×22, font 1.02rem, radius 14, max-height 60vh scroll)

Guide VI fixes: 'bằng lái' → 'chứng chỉ chuyên ngành', 'tâm thế' → 'tình hình', 'VŨ TRỤ' → 'vũ trụ'; guide.1 updated to 30s + offline mention (EN/VI/ZH); new guide.7 about random career/business events (EN/VI/ZH)

Offline catch-up: new engine.applyOffline() — on mount + on tab-visible, advances time at OFFLINE_DAY_MS for elapsed since s.lastSeen (capped 30 days), applies extra unsupervised-business closure roll (~2%/day) + operational losses, returns a summary toast; GameState gains lastSeen field (null-safe for old saves)
Game clock rewrite: visible ticks refresh lastSeen; hidden stamps lastSeen + persists; beforeunload stamps lastSeen; mount runs applyOffline + toast
AI oracle event rate bumped 3% → 4% per game-day (more in-work situations, good and bad)
Version bumped to v11.12 on homepage header + version.json
